name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
title: Western Carriers (India) Ltd - 544258 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Western Carriers is a rail-based logistics operator, not a cables maker, so subsector is a poor fit; Q4 EXIM containers fell 3.2% YoY and 11% QoQ, EBITDA margin slipped to 5%, and management gave no numbers but promised sequential improvement.

capex.quote: We reduced our capex from the planned INR100 crores last year to about INR74 odd crores this year, seeing the variation in the EXIM trade.

triggers.label: Debtors above INR600 cr; days target <120
triggers.quote: who are these end parties who owe INR600 plus crores in receivables?

triggers.label: Q4 EXIM containers down 10.96% QoQ
triggers.quote: the 34,404 EXIM numbers are compared to the 38,638 containers in Q3 of this year, which shows a reduction of 4,234 containers

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR100 cr, tied to demand
triggers.quote: our intention is a further capex of INR100 crores in this FY27, which remains linked to strong customer demand and will be calibrated to market conditions

triggers.label: Domestic containers up 17.8% YoY in Q4
triggers.quote: the domestic numbers have increased to 23,350 from 19,824 an absolute increase of 3,526 containers

guidance.quote: we hope to bring it back to where we were starting FY25 which is around almost 7%
We are targeting to bring our debtor days to below 120 in this current financial year.
our intention is a further capex of INR100 crores in this FY27

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow FY25 and FY26
red_flags.quote: your operating cash flow has been negative in both these years

red_flags.label: Debt up INR172 cr to INR217 cr despite IPO proceeds
red_flags.quote: your debt has gone up from INR172 crores to INR217 crores

red_flags.label: Receivables rising; debtor days above target
red_flags.quote: our debtor days has definitely not been coming to the target that we would like

red_flags.label: Refused segment breakup and margin split
red_flags.quote: we do not salami slice our numbers

evasions.quote: Don't want to give any future forward guidance Priyanka
So it's hard to really say what are the margins in domestic movements compared to EXIM.
we do not salami slice our revenues per se
The timing of operating cash flow improvement will depend on realizations, collecting cycles
